summary: Trump announced cancellation of the Iran agreement, escalating tensions with Iran's readiness for expanded conflict. Israeli airstrikes targeted Saudi forces in the Red Sea, while Hezbollah and Iranian generals discussed regional escalation. Lebanon reported 84 alerts and 57 drone sightings, with intense activity in the Nabatiye district.
key_points: Trump declared the Iran agreement canceled, stating Iran will never acquire nuclear weapons under any circumstances. (Source: @mamlekate/104169)
Iranian Revolutionary Guard forces discussed expanding the war with Hezbollah and Houthis during a ceasefire pause. (Source: @asafroz/52508)
Israeli airstrikes hit a Saudi military site in the Red Sea near Al-Muh'ha, destroying a military vessel and four Saudi ships. (Source: @New_security8200/203339)
Lebanon's end-of-day report recorded 84 alerts, 57 drone sightings, and 16 artillery bombardments, with 46 incidents in the Nabatiye district. (Source: @redlinkleb/37106)
Israeli forces besieged Qusra in the West Bank for nine days, declaring it a closed military zone and restricting access to supplies. (Source: @presstv/203175)
Iranian officials stated their forces have a transformative, offensive approach and are preparing for a broader conflict with the US. (Source: @mamlekate/104163)
US Navy MH-60 Sea Hawk operated over USS Mason enforcing a blockade against Iran, redirecting 64 commercial vessels and boarding 2. (Source: @shin_persian/8995)

sections.threat_assessment: The cancellation of the Iran agreement by Trump signals a significant escalation, with Iran preparing for a broader conflict with the US. Israeli airstrikes on Saudi forces in the Red Sea indicate potential regionalization of the conflict. Hezbollah and Iranian generals' discussions suggest coordinated expansion of hostilities. The besieging of Qusra in the West Bank and increased drone activity in Lebanon heighten the risk of broader regional engagement.
sections.regional_response: Turkey and Iran discussed regional developments, with Iran emphasizing diplomatic efforts to prevent escalation. Pakistan hosted a UN disarmament conference, reflecting regional diplomatic engagement. Oman's role in mediating between Iran and the US remains critical. The US Navy's blockade enforcement against Iran demonstrates ongoing military posturing in the region.
sections.intelligence_notes: The cancellation of the Iran agreement by Trump marks a pivotal shift in US policy, potentially leading to direct confrontation. Iranian forces' readiness for expanded conflict with the US indicates a high risk of escalation. Israeli airstrikes on Saudi forces suggest a willingness to engage regional actors. The increased drone and artillery activity in Lebanon underscores the volatility of the southern front.
